description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wiguhumpola, Harispaththuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320332 (23/0178))
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (No. 38 of Block 01) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, owner information, and title classification. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registration, title determination, and property ownership matters.
